title: Windward Stair - The Long Climb
_note: Option A anchor. gbc 4-voice band. Vesper motif CLIMBING transform: the spine (rising leap that overshoots + stepwise settle) is sequenced upward, each 4-bar phrase re-launching a scale-step higher so the loop FEELS like ascent. Crash 'wind-swell' crests each switchback every 4 bars. 16-bar loop; last bar steps down to E (the dominant) -> voice-leads back up into the bar-1 A-major lift.
